Temporary.hint: Select the actual NPCs representing these bodies or new instances. Their level, Health, attacks and appearance must already match the declared source profile. The GM confirms physical eligibility and range before payment. Each new invocation starts at the ability's level plus its paid Effort; temporary companions share the normal follower asset cap.
Temporary.corpseHint: Basic Necromancy uses its acquired Type or Focus version. Intact corpses retain damage. The Focus versions may restore a destroyed body to full Health only after confirmed repair; the Type version cannot reanimate a destroyed corpse. Improved/Greater/True Necromancy support batches at their source costs.
Temporary.duplicateHint: Select one empty NPC profile per new instance. Copies of your clothing and equipment appear without cyphers or artifacts; memories and appearance are confirmed by the GM. Allocate one Effort level for each extra instance and each level increase. New instances replace the prior Duplicate group. Dismissal is an extra action on your turn; a killed instance causes a moderate wound.
Temporary.machineHint: Companion branch only: confirm a machine within long range, pay for an Intellect attack, and declare its reboot duration in rounds. Dedicated Effort raises the maximum affected level from 4. Successful recompilation changes no Health. Control expires after your ten-hour recovery, not a fixed 24-hour timer. Bricking and explosion belong to the later offensive family.
Temporary.range: Every selected body or machine is within the source's range; each new instance appears at a visible point within short range
Temporary.machine: The selected target is a machine eligible for recompilation
Temporary.newInstances: The selected empty NPC profiles represent new instances of me, with matching appearance and source-appropriate Health and attacks
Temporary.corpses: These are eligible dead bodies of the source-permitted size; their living memories and special powers are absent
Temporary.repaired: The GM confirms required repairs of every destroyed corpse selected
Temporary.levelEffort: Dedicated Effort for this instance's level (or the machine level limit)
Temporary.easeEffort: Separate paid Effort to ease the Intellect attack
Temporary.rebootHint: Confirm that the declared rounds elapsed. Combat can finish a reboot automatically at its saved round; outside combat, declare completed narrative rounds.
Temporary.abandonHint: End these unfinished bodies or instances. Spent Pool points remain spent; earlier bodies or instances are not restored.
Temporary.inventory: Temporary companion equipment and retained loot
Temporary.unavailable: Temporary companion unavailable: check GM authority, canonical source, NPC profile, permissions, eligibility, range, Effort, resources, pending settlement and action timing.
